reviewer_statement: Real native R raw-irregular PS/LP scientific fit of FDApy 1.0.3 UFPCA covariance-operator estimand: source unclamped B-spline penalized mean/covariance or Epanechnikov local-polynomial mean/covariance smoothing, zero-penalty PS FIT centering, observed-time pairwise covariance, correct PS vs LP diagonal handling, FDApy rounded order-2 difference sequence noise, trapezoid-weighted eigensystem, source public transform's SECOND LP centering, internal np.interp pooled-grid score smoothing, source max(noise,tol) spectral-covariance PACE pseudoinverse and inverse reconstruction. Native R scientific arrays, not backend Python object; normalize TRUE and broader Python exception/kwargs/eigenvector sign/order domains remain unqualified. Real source differential authored, passing CI not yet observed.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R independent fit without fdapace or Python; opt-in strict_source_record=TRUE. The historical native R explicit backend='fdapace' remains unchanged by default. Native R eigensolver yields sorted eigenvalues/sign-indeterminate eigenvectors; source NumPy linalg.eig does not guarantee ordering/sign, so compare matched eigenspaces and sign/permutation aligned scores; no fabricated source backend instance.

case_evidence.description: Frozen source public fit_sparse_fpca_fdapy chooses UFPCA(n_components,method='covariance',normalize), fits actual FDApy mean/covariance smoothing on irregular observations, calls transform with explicit original data and method='PACE' score_smoothing/tol, returns sparse scientific results plus backend_data/model and reconstruction. Native full strict opts from NULL snapshot into raw PS/LP fitting; supplied snapshot retains conditional score-only semantics.

Native source-scientific domain: finite complete selected irregular time observations, ncurves >=3 and 1<=n_components<=ncurves-1, sorted exact pooled evaluation grid, fit smoothing PS or LP with reviewed kwargs, default LP score smoother and tol>0, normalize=FALSE, PS tensor basis <=1600 coefficients and LP degree 0..2; unverified arbitrary Python mapping/NaN, normalize TRUE, score PS and object exceptions excluded.

Exact source mathematical pipeline: uniform unclamped B-splines and P-spline normal-equation smoothing; univariate/bivariate local-polynomial source weights with np.linalg.lstsq rcond 1e-10; fit-stage zero-penalty mean resmoothing; raw pooled covariance with PS weights captured before diagonal-zero and LP diagonal excluded; difference sequence .809,-.5,-.309 noise; weighted covariance eigensystem; source score-stage separate mean LP smoothing, pooled np.interp with boundary extension, BLUP scores from inverse(C_spectral+noise I) and Karhunen-Loeve inverse reconstruction.

Native source bounded mode explicitly rejects non-finite selected irregular curves, unsorted/unsupported grids, invalid ranks, normalize TRUE, source PS score mode with forwarded tol, unsupported kwargs/diagonal options, higher LP degrees and excessive tensor basis; source exact ImportError/type errors and general object or degeneracy exceptions not qualified.

The native typed etr_fdapy_native_ufpca_ps_lp_scientific_record has source scientific SparseFPCAResult core score/eigenvalue/meta/unit/fit-method fields and complete source fitted means, source-fit/source-score centered observations, raw/smoothed covariance matrices, quadrature weights, fitted eigenfunctions, difference-noise, source PACE reconstruction as R records. Python FDApy UFPCA/backend_data/reconstructed_backend object identity NULL, full source class parity false.

Sparse functional PCA of univariate irregular trajectories through FDApy original pooled-grid covariance operator with source PS/LP smoothing, trapezoid-weighted spectral decomposition and conditional-expectation PACE scoring. Scientifically identifies component eigenspaces, variance spectra, scores modulo signs/ordering; raw trajectories are not interpolated before covariance fitting; internal source score interpolation is explicitly performed.
